Four nits remain, none affecting a mark. Ready to graduate after wave 1, together with Structure/Jets.

checks.mark_prop1: DEC-120: 'Prop. 1 with U read connected'. 1°: existsUnique_smul_eq_of_isPreconnected (IsPreconnected U, U.Nonempty — i.e. Mathlib's IsConnected, Bourbaki's connexe; φ₁.source = φ₂.source = U, both compatible; ∃! g, ∀ y ∈ U, φ₁ y = g • φ₂ y). 2°: existsUnique_compatibleChart_jet (IsPreconnected U, x ∈ U; existence and uniqueness up to EqOnSource = equal on U; existence alone for every U: exists_compatibleChart_jet). Rigidity is IsAnalyticAction, an instance for GSR n and GAR n. The docstring states the reading and the remarks; the REPORT has findings [] and the row 'reading (DEC-120, ruled)'. Earned
checks.mark_remarque: remarque_affine_vers_projective: for ANY l ≠ 0 (Fact) and ANY j : ℝⁿ → openHemisphere l with IsAffine ℝ j (Déf. 6's structure) and j injective, it derives (not assumes) that ι = coe ∘ j is an open embedding and that φ : GAR n →* GSR n (conj σ ∘ affToGS) makes ι equivariant; the charts j ∘ φ give HasGroupoid (projGroupoid n) (« J''(V) définit sur V une structure de variété localement projective »); its jets are exactly {jetSMul g ⟨x, γ.map j⟩ | g ∈ GS(n), ⟨x, γ⟩ ∈ J(V)} = GS ∘ j ∘ J(V) = J''(V); and its maximal atlas equals the one transported along the standard chart s(·,1). maximalAtlas_transport_indep: for j into openHemisphere l and j' into openHemisphere l' (two possibly different hemispheres), both affine injective, the two transported structures have the same maximal atlas; pp.explicit confirms both sides use `transportChartedSpace hι` / `hι'` (there is no ambient ChartedSpace (S n) V). The IsOpenEmbedding arguments hι, hι' of maximalAtlas_transport_indep are needed only to name the transported charted spaces; they are Props supplied by remarque_affine_vers_projective, so the statement is not weakened. 'ANY open hemisphere': every open hemisphere of S(n) is openHemisphere l for an l ≠ 0 (Déf. 5), and Déf. 6's structure on it does not depend on l (hemi_vadd_indep, WP-45f), so the quantification over (l, j) covers every « isomorphisme compatible avec la structure affine de ℝⁿ sur un hémisphère »; the generalisation from isomorphism to injective affine map is a strengthening (an injective affine map ℝⁿ → H is onto by dimension). Non-vacuity: instantiated in scratch with l = lastForm n, j = hemiChartH. Earned

fidelity_summary: Déf. 13, Prop. 1 (U connected and nonempty, DEC-120) and Prop. 3 are proved as printed; the Remarque is proved in its strongest form: for every affine injection of ℝⁿ into every open hemisphere of S(n), the transported structure is locally projective, its jets are J''(V) = GS ∘ j ∘ J(V), and it does not depend on j. Déf. 12's jet ⟺ atlas equivalence is here and its topological half is in Structure/Jets. All marks are earned.
